data.gender_notes: Izat is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word ‘izzah’ meaning honor, respect, and dignity. In Islamic tradition, Izat is given to remind parents and the child of the importance of maintaining one's dignity and respect for oneself and others. The name Izat carries the meaning “Honor, Respect, Dignity” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Izat usually hope their child will grow to embody honor, respect, dignity and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of God's Honor and Respect
data.etymology: Izat belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Honor, Respect, Dignity.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Izat total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_arabic.name: عزت
in_arabic.long_meaning: عزت کا مطلب ہے شرف، کرامت، اور عظمت۔ یہ نام عربی زبان سے نکلا ہے جہاں 'عزت' کا معنی ہے کسی کی شان و شوکت، عظمت، اور کرامت۔ قرآن مجید میں بھی عزت کے متعلق آیات ہیں جیسے کہ 'وَلِلَّهِ الْعِزَّةُ وَلِرَسُولِهِ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ' (المنافقون: 8) یعنی اللہ تعالیٰ کے لئے عزت ہے، اور اُس کے رسول اور مومنوں کے لئے بھی۔

in_urdu.name: عزت
in_urdu.long_meaning: عزت نام کا مطلب ہے عزت، شان و شوکت، اور کرامت۔ یہ نام عربی زبان کے 'عزت' سے نکلا ہے جس کا مطلب ہے کسی کی عظمت، شان، اور کرامت۔ جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں کے لئے یہ نام بہت اہمیت رکھتا ہے کیونکہ یہ نام فرد کی عزت، فخر، اور کرامت کو ظاہر کرتا ہے۔ تاریخی طور پر بھی، عزت جیسے نام اسلامی تقویم میں اہم کردار ادا کرتے رہے ہیں۔

in_hindi.name: इज़्ज़त
in_hindi.long_meaning: इज़्ज़त नाम का अर्थ है सम्मान, इज़्ज़त, और महानता। यह नाम अरबी भाषा से आया है, जहाँ 'इज़्ज़त' का अर्थ है किसी की गरिमा, सम्मान, और महानता। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, यह नाम बहुत महत्व रखता है क्योंकि यह नाम व्यक्ति की गरिमा, गर्व, और सम्मान को दर्शाता है।

in_pashto.name: عزت
in_pashto.long_meaning: عزت نوم معنی دی عزت، درنښت، او ویاړ. دا نوم د عربي ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی دی چیرته چې 'عزت' معنی یې د چا د ویاړ، عظمت، او کرامت. په افغان او پښتون دود کې، دا نوم ډیر اهمیت لري ځکه چې دا نوم د فرد ویاړ، فخر، او کرامت څرګندوي.

in_english.name: Izat
in_english.long_meaning: The name Izat originates from the Arabic root 'عزت' (ʿ-z-t), which conveys meanings of honor, dignity, greatness, and nobility. In Islamic tradition, Izat is associated with attributes of respect, prestige, and grandeur. The Quran references the concept of honor and dignity in several verses, emphasizing the importance of maintaining one's honor and integrity. Historically, names like Izat have been significant in Muslim cultures, symbolizing the values of respect and nobility.

historical_references.reference: Izat, a title bestowed upon the Mughal Emperors of India, signifying 'Dignity' or 'Majesty'. The title was first used by Emperor Akbar in the 16th century as a part of his regal titles.

Izat was also a title used by the Ottoman Sultans of the late 15th and 16th centuries, denoting 'Glory' or 'Honor'. The title was a part of the Ottoman imperial titulature and was used alongside other titles such as 'Sultan' and 'Khan'.
